summary: Read all 17 distinct bodies across 22 occurrences, including all graphics stages and the final wiring/execute order. Preserve the explicit render passes and energy-band math; revise redundant context/property ceremony and stale control comments. These are source-reading findings, not a graphics run verdict.

lenses.smells_idioms: The graph exports typed paintSource, paintHalf, paintQuarter, paintMedium, paintBroad and apertureControl properties along the exact parent chains used by consumers. props.kt macro_prop propagates typed accessors to children; stdlib_properties.kt Inheritance reads nearest properties. Repeated named context queries plus !! and redundant thisBox qualification obscure this normal API. Renderer is already inherited correctly. Named preTargets entries preserve source/reduction/filter order; RenderTarget renders that map before screen modules.
lenses.imports: Explicit RenderToTexture/fromContextWithNameOrNull imports and VK10.* recur. No deterministic import-analyzer output is supplied in this bounded assignment or found under build/box-code-revision; leave removals to coordinator analysis. In particular do not remove the LWJGL star on visual inspection. The source box does not visibly call the named lookup, but that is only a candidate pending analyzer evidence.
lenses.whitespace: Kotlin resource setup, attachment, push controls and nesting form recognizable groups. Compact vector/Rect arguments and dense GLSL math can be mechanically spaced; keep six sprite corners as an authored vertex table and do not change draw counts or loop bounds. No synthetic fragment breaks.
lenses.comments: Keep RGBA energy-band/alpha blend=false explanation, pixel radii, negative viewport UV convention, black-border sampling and downstream resize instruction. Composite comment claims B/G keyboard controls absent from every body; source look comment also advertises unused z/w controls.
lenses.glsl: Read all 9 distinct shader bodies: fullscreen vertex shared by six boxes, source, two reduction variants, medium/broad filters, composite and sprite vertex/fragment. Bindings match Kotlin texture names; medium uses gb and broad a; final additive output preserves alpha. Retain exact overlap-area branches, anti-aliasing and fixed sampling loops. No proven shader behavior defect from source reading.
lenses.live_coding: No authored //%- markers or declaration/reset duplicates to remove. Preserve controls.set at line 425 as the documented line to re-execute and mesh push-property assignments as editable control points. Rerunning upstream creates new RTT values; obey existing downstream rerun instruction and preserve execution order. Rerun behavior needs native verification before claiming it works.
lenses.helpers: Checked BOX_CODE_HELPER_IDEAS.md: typed properties and generated push members already exist; no new lookup helper needed. Do not propose declined addPassChain or automatic dispatch. fullscreenTriangle is approved follow-up, but replacing these explicit editable shader properties should not be silently folded into this review.

findings.issue: Each consumer repeats fallible named queries for properties already declared by its ancestors; half even queries paintSource twice under source/input aliases. This adds local stale references and hides the graph contract. API basis: document/properties/props.kt macro_prop and stdlib_properties.kt Inheritance; wiring is explicit at transcript lines 528-545.
findings.proposed_change: Use inherited paintSource directly for sizes, paintSource/paintHalf/paintQuarter directly in textures, and inherited paintMedium/paintBroad in composite. Retain a clearly documented captured reference only if needed for deliberate snapshot semantics; these boxes do not start async work. Apply to bodies 5, 7, 9, 11 and 13.
findings.verification: Replay the full transcript and compile each dependent box after parents. Rerun source then downstream in documented order and capture all four defocus rows, sharp mode and radius-guide mode.

findings.issue: The source box repeatedly qualifies its own typed properties and layout fields with thisBox although the executing box is the implicit receiver. The same body already uses bare paintSource in moduleHere.
findings.proposed_change: Use paintSource/apertureControl/frame/inside directly when they refer to this box. Keep thisBox where it is the actual nestedIn argument, since that value is required. Do not merge the separate property declaration and assignment by default.
findings.verification: Compile/replay body 2 with original nesting and verify nested boxes remain positioned correctly; capture the source/reduction hierarchy.

summary: Read all 40 distinct fences, including symbolic API sketches, runnable capture fences, inline loops, controls, service-backed audio continuations and offline synth snapshots. Revise one existing-helper opportunity, raw-property teaching, mixed-preview refresh, and one dense timeline layout. Do not treat schematic prerequisites or static figures as tested behavior.

lenses.smells_idioms: Most fences use normal box receivers and named output channels. The syncToProperty snippet reads a raw cast into a one-time local snapshot instead of showing a typed property. Source control callbacks update their variables, while the mixed preview markdown is emitted once. FieldAudio snippets are asynchronous API sketches with external asset/result prerequisites; no cancellation or service-success claim established here.
lenses.imports: Bodies 35/40 contain kotlin.math.* and afield.audio.synth.*. Import analyzer evidence is unavailable for these bodies, so neither star is proposed for removal. All import decisions remain coordinator mechanical work with preamble/resolution evidence.
lenses.whitespace: Preserve matrix numeric rows, map entries, control initial arrays and markdown table rows. Most examples already group setup and output clearly; body 35 compresses three independently editable timeline viewers into long nested calls and warrants expanded argument groups. Body 11 imaging stages retain their one-value-per-row comments.
lenses.comments: Inline-loop comments explain sampling cadence; control playhead comments distinguish output handles from stored controls; audio offsets/URL-vs-inline samples comments are useful. Rewrite mixed-preview historical comment (hand-built any more) to explain what callbacks refresh. Preserve setup dependency context for scene/analysis/result excerpts rather than pretending every fence is standalone.
lenses.glsl: No GLSL bodies or embedded shader strings in these 40 fences. The HTML swatch in body 27 is CSS, not GLSL; if edited, use a solid dark monochrome composition per user design instruction.
lenses.live_coding: No authored fragment markers to add/remove and no reset pairs to collapse. Bodies 13/15/16/17 explicitly call frame; Phased.kt loop already auto-advances only when body has not, so these calls are valid, not double advancement. Bodies 28-30 correctly rely on auto-advance. Body 40 manually renders newly created isolated synth graphs for static snapshots; Signal.kt allows offline contexts, and this review does not recommend rendering an audio-owned graph from Runloop. A persistent context migration requires a real public cycle API, not merely hoisting SynthContext and leaving cycleId fixed.
lenses.helpers: Checked Already in Field, Approved, Declined and Open helper lists. Spiral initial-point branching is exactly the existing breakNext pattern; use it rather than proposing a new helper. Typed prop exists for gain. No new helper proposals and no duplicate of declined helpers.

findings.snippet: if (i == 0) spiral.moveTo(x, y) else spiral.lineTo(x, y)
findings.issue: The spiral manually branches for the first vertex although FLine.breakNext() is already the supported path-start helper; this is the exact pattern called out in BOX_CODE_HELPER_IDEAS.md. FLine.lineTo checks breakNext and emits moveTo once.
findings.proposed_change: Call spiral.breakNext() before the loop and use spiral.lineTo(x, y) for every point. Preserve inclusive 0..steps, geometry constants and separate x/y calculations.
findings.verification: Compile/run the fence and compare node count, bounds and spiral thumbnail against original; first node must remain MoveTo and remaining nodes LineTo.

findings.issue: The box-property example teaches a raw cast and binds gain to a snapshot that does not follow later slider writes. syncToProperty already initializes/persists the property, while macro_prop supplies its typed inheritable accessor.
findings.proposed_change: Declare prop<Double>(gain), call syncToProperty with the same name and keep subsequent reads through gain. Do not assign gain=0.5 on every rerun, since that would discard the saved control value. Use propDown only when intentionally teaching reader reruns.
findings.verification: Compile in a real box, drag gain, read it again without rerunning setup, rerun box and reload document to verify persistence; preserve distinction from the following propDown paragraph.

findings.issue: All five callbacks only assign locals, and the markdown preview is sent once after controlGroup creation. Dragging WIND or BLOOM or changing LABEL/TRAILS leaves its displayed readout stale until a full rerun; tint never affects the hardcoded swatch. This is source control-flow evidence, not a UI-tested failure.
findings.proposed_change: Define an updatePreview function that emits current readout values and a solid dark monochrome swatch, call it after each control update and after initial group setup. Keep initial cached-control restoration ordering valid and give any swatch parameter a visible effect. Replace historical comment with the callback-refresh intent; follow the user no-gradients preference.
findings.verification: Run docs.visualizers.controls.mixed-surface, interact with all five widgets in the real output iframe, inspect changing preview text/swatch, rerun with cached settings, and recapture the figure after the final values settle.

findings.proposed_change: Lay out the three independent viewers with one named argument per line and split the with(Functions) block over readable lines. Preserve shared sync, rate, ping closure, interval, sampleStep, viewKey and current function/ping alignment; add no fragment boundaries.
findings.verification: Compile/run docs viewer capture and inspect all three timeline panels; zoom/seek must remain synchronized across the same group. Keep import analysis separate from layout.
